# Adoption rule with intervals (descriptive; generated by `docs/evidence/v10_adoption_intervals.py`; no verdict is changed)

Bar: held-out one-vs-rest AUROC >= 0.7; adoption needs >= 27 of the core 28 detectors. `DET_PASS` = 95% lower bound >= 0.7; `DET_FAIL` = upper bound < 0.7; `UNCERTAIN` = the interval contains 0.7; `THIN` = run flagged < 50 held-out positives.

| Run | Stored verdict | Stored detector count | DET_PASS | UNCERTAIN | DET_FAIL | THIN | Count range from the data | Does the data decide the 27 rule? | Uncertain detectors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| judged_cpu_run_seed42 | ADOPTED | 28 | 27 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 27 to 28 | yes: adopted on any reading | C2 (0.81) |
| judged_cpu_run_seed43 | ADOPTED | 28 | 27 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 27 to 28 | yes: adopted on any reading | K04 (0.80) |
| judged_cpu_run_v2_seed44 | ADOPTED | 28 | 28 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 28 to 28 | yes: adopted on any reading |  |
| judged_cpu_run_v3_seed45 | ADOPTED | 27 | 26 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 26 to 27 | NO: depends on the uncertain detectors | C2 (0.78) |
| judged_cpu_run_v4_seed47 | ADOPTED | 28 | 26 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 26 to 28 | NO: depends on the uncertain detectors | Q03 (0.70), K04 (0.77) |
| judged_cpu_run_v5_seed49 | NOT_ADOPTED | 24 | 24 | 1 | 0 | 3 | 24 to 25 | yes: not adopted on any reading | Q03 (0.64) |
| judged_cpu_run_v6_seed50 | ADOPTED | 28 | 27 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 27 to 28 | yes: adopted on any reading | Q03 (0.70) |
| judged_cpu_run_v7_seed50 | ADOPTED | 28 | 27 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 27 to 28 | yes: adopted on any reading | Q03 (0.70) |
| judged_gpu_v3_seed46 | ADOPTED | 27 | 27 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 27 to 28 | yes: adopted on any reading | Q03 (0.65) |
| judged_gpu_v4_seed48 | NOT_ADOPTED | 26 | 26 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 26 to 28 | NO: depends on the uncertain detectors | Q03 (0.69), C2 (0.61) |
| judged_gpu_v6_seed50 | ADOPTED | 27 | 26 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 26 to 28 | NO: depends on the uncertain detectors | Q03 (0.64), C2 (0.75) |
| judged_gpu_v8_seed52 | NOT_ADOPTED | 26 | 26 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 26 to 27 | NO: depends on the uncertain detectors | C2 (0.68) |

Reading. A run whose count range straddles 27 has a verdict that rests on detectors whose intervals contain the bar: re-measuring the same construction could flip it. That is a statement about the measurement, not about the method, and it is why v6 (adopted) and v8 (not adopted) differ by one detector (C2) without a distinguishable change.
